name: Modern Next.js Dashboard with shadcn/ui
summary: Next.js 14 admin dashboard template with shadcn/ui: sidebar layout, stats overview, recent activity and auth routes.
description: A responsive admin dashboard starter built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui. It provides a dashboard layout with sidebar navigation, a stats overview (revenue, subscriptions, sales, active users), recent activity and quick actions, plus prepared authentication routes and components. Customization goes through globals.css and components.json.
contains: Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui
stats overview: revenue, subscriptions, sales, active users
MIT licensed, 110 stars, live Vercel demo
